item.description: Typst 0.15 arrives with expanded features and tooling improvements, though heavy reliance on newer compilation formats risks fragmenting older template ecosystems.

item.title: Engineering a Semantic Code Search Pipeline Without the Magic
item.description: This architectural breakdown examines the mechanics of implementing retrieval-augmented generation for codebase search, noting the persistent friction between lexical precision and semantic drift. While embedding models offer a bridge across sprawling repositories, they frequently substitute surface-level pattern matching for true structural understanding.

item.title: Bill Draper, Venture Capitalist and Early Tech Investor, Dies
item.description: Bill Draper, a foundational figure in venture capital who helped shape Silicon Valley's financing infrastructure, has passed away. His legacy leaves an open question about whether modern software funding can retain any long-term commitment to foundational engineering craft.

The Shift from DIY Self-Hosting to Hosted Services
item.description: While self-hosting offers ultimate control and cost efficiency using old hardware or a cheap VPS, modern tech consumers increasingly prefer turnkey, paid solutions like Fastmail or ProtonMail over DIY alternatives for custom email needs. Quote: It's never been easier to self-host, but it feels like, in general, when faced with 'I want to do X with a computer,' people are more and more reaching for paid, hosted services rather than DIY anymore.
